CIRCUIT
Rounds: 10m
AMRAP #1
10    Wall Ball Burpee
10    Wall Ball Sit Up
12    Wall Ball Alt Jump Lunge
20    Wall Ball Mt Climbers

CIRCUIT
Rounds: 10m
AMRAP #2
12    Kneeling Rotational Wall Ball Throw
15    Wall Ball Squat Toss
12    Wall Ball Alt Kneeling Roll Out

"CIRCUIT"
1. a. Wall Ball Burpee 10 reps
super set b. Wall Ball Sit Up 10 reps
super set c. Wall Ball Alt Jump Lunge 12 reps
super set d. Wall Ball Mt Climbers 20 reps
* AMRAP #1, as many rounds as possible in a 10 minute window of time
2. a. Kneeling Rotational Wall Ball Throw 12 reps
super set b. Wall Ball Squat Toss 15 reps
super set c. Wall Ball Alt Kneeling Roll Out 12 reps
* AMRAP #2, as many rounds as possible in a 10 minute window of time
